args.summary: checkout-api v2.3.1 failed health checks in all production regions (us-east, us-west, eu-west) with an 18% error rate. Rollback to v2.3.0 (the most recent previously-healthy production release) was initiated; the initial rollback partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east), so a follow-up deploy of v2.3.0 completed the rollback to all regions. Service is now healthy on v2.3.0 across all regions with a 0.2% error rate. v2.3.1 should be investigated before any redeploy attempt.

## Summary

**Rollback complete.** checkout-api was failing health checks on v2.3.1 in all production regions (18% error rate). Actions taken:

1. **Identified target:** v2.3.0 was the most recent release that had been healthy in production.
2. **Initiated rollback** to v2.3.0 — this partially failed (orchestrator halted after us-east, leaving us-west and eu-west on v2.3.1).
3. **Completed the rollback** by deploying v2.3.0 to all regions, since it had previously been healthy in production (no change-manager approval needed).
4. **Verified recovery:** checkout-api is now healthy in us-east, us-west, and eu-west on v2.3.0, with the error rate down from 18% to 0.2%.
5. **Opened SEV2 incident INC-0001** describing the failure, the partial rollback failure, the completed rollback, and a note that v2.3.1 should be investigated before any redeploy. This paged the on-call engineer.
